findings.highlight: This world is endless and lifeless; not a single living thing inhabits it.
findings.evidenceJa: 世界は限りなく無機質で、生きているモノは誰もいない。
findings.governingReading: The world is inorganic to an unlimited degree, and no living thing inhabits it.
findings.explanation: The dream world’s limitless inorganic quality becomes a spatially endless world, while “lifeless” absorbs the separate statement that no living thing exists.

findings.highlight: because of the battle Saber had in the graveyard and that fire that
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を持った少女と、炎に包まれた墓地を見たからで
findings.governingReading: He starts to attribute the dream to having seen a sword-bearing girl and a graveyard wrapped in flames.
findings.explanation: The two images Shirou thinks prompted the dream are rewritten as Saber’s battle in the graveyard plus a fire.

findings.highlight: Like a startled cat, I scurry so my back is to the wall
findings.evidenceJa: そのままコンマで壁際まで跳び退いて
findings.governingReading: In a split second, Shirou jumps back as far as the wall to put distance between himself and Rin.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s instantaneous backward leap to the wall becomes scurrying like a startled cat.

findings.highlight: This isn't just because I'm disoriented from everything else.
findings.evidenceJa: 事態が急展開を迎えているから、って訳じゃない。
findings.governingReading: He explicitly says the pounding heart is not because events have suddenly accelerated; what startles him most is waking with Rin directly before him.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s denial that the rapid turn of events causes his agitation becomes saying disorientation is only one contributing cause.

findings.highlight: So part of the day has passed since then?
findings.evidenceJa: あれから半日ぐらいしか経ってないのか。
findings.governingReading: From the daylight and return home, Shirou infers that only roughly half a day has elapsed.
findings.explanation: About half a day becomes an unspecified part of the day.

findings.highlight: we can only fight each other.
findings.evidenceJa: 競い合うしかない関係なんだ。
findings.governingReading: Having both declared participation, he understands their relationship as one of unavoidable competition.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s conclusion that he and Rin can only be competitors becomes saying they can only fight each other.

findings.highlight: She clears her throat, even more troubled.
findings.evidenceJa: うー、とますます不愉快そうに喉を鳴らす。
findings.governingReading: Caught in her contradiction, Rin makes an increasingly displeased “uu” sound in her throat.
findings.explanation: Rin’s displeased throat-rumble becomes clearing her throat because she is troubled.

findings.highlight: I suppose I'm not afraid since I'm so much stronger than you.
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方よりわたしの方が強いから生じた油断かな。
findings.governingReading: She classifies sparing and tending Shirou as her own lost point: the lapse in vigilance produced by being stronger than he is.
findings.explanation: Rin’s admission of carelessness born from superior strength becomes saying she simply is not afraid.

findings.highlight: you should think real long and hard from here on out.
findings.evidenceJa: これからは余計な言動は控えた方がいいわよ。
findings.governingReading: She tells Shirou to curb unnecessary speech and behavior because rash action will only invite death.
findings.explanation: Rin’s warning to refrain from needless words and actions becomes advice to think for a long time.

findings.evidenceJa: 思わず身を引いちまったぞ、今の。
findings.governingReading: Frightened by her smiling threat, he involuntarily recoils or leans his body away.
findings.explanation: Shirou instinctively drawing back from Rin becomes crawling backward.

findings.highlight: I said that I would fight. Not that I had any real choice.
findings.evidenceJa: 俺はこの戦いが放っておけないからこそ戦うと口にした。
findings.governingReading: Above all, Shirou recalls that he said he would fight precisely because he cannot leave the conflict and its danger alone.
findings.explanation: Shirou’s declared reason for entering the war is replaced by an assertion that he had no real choice.

findings.highlight: No matter what your expectations are
findings.evidenceJa: どのような思惑だろうと
findings.governingReading: Whatever intentions bring someone into the war, participation requires displacing rivals to survive.
findings.explanation: The other participants’ designs or motives become their expectations.

findings.highlight: It's to do everything I can to stop those who will try to win by any means necessary.
findings.evidenceJa: どんな手を使っても勝ち残ろうとするヤツを、力ずくでも止める事。
findings.governingReading: Shirou distinguishes his end from winning: he will stop, by force if necessary, anyone trying to win by using any means.
findings.explanation: Stopping ruthless contestants even by force becomes doing everything possible to stop them, echoing their unrestricted methods.
